name: Relation Preservation Scrutiny Registry
purpose: Explicitly stress-test whether ⇔R remains irreducible under reviewer reinterpretation pressure.

scrutiny_tests.description: Attempt to replace ⇔R with standard logical biconditional IFF.
scrutiny_tests.findings: ⇔R is an operator of recursive co-generation, not a truth-value link. Substitution loses process directionality.

scrutiny_tests.description: Attempt to treat ⇔R as one-way implication (If E!=0 then delta).
scrutiny_tests.findings: One-way reading violates the 'one-process' mandate where E and delta are inseparable aspects.

scrutiny_tests.description: Attempt to treat relational equivalence as object identity (=).
scrutiny_tests.findings: Relational equivalence (≡) is context-bounded by A_alpha; absolute identity assumes context-free existence.

scrutiny_tests.description: Attempt to define E or delta as independent substances.
scrutiny_tests.findings: Aspects possess no independent ontological status outside the relation.

scrutiny_tests.description: Attempt to validate a projected image without its source_relation trace.
scrutiny_tests.findings: Projected images are incomplete by definition; separation produces ungoverned artifacts.

governance_rules.rule: Any reviewer attempt to collapse the relation ⇔R triggers an immediate 'INADMISSIBLE_INTERPRETATION' flag.
